# **Minecraft's Most Realistic Disneyland Recreation**
For the past 8+ years, we have been making the most faithful recreation of the happiest place the world has ever seen.

Our network is known for its friendly and welcoming community, where players of all ages can come together and enjoy the game in a safe and positive environment. We have a dedicated and experienced staff team who are always on hand to help out and ensure that everyone is having a great time.

Experience Disneyland in Minecraft, recreated in a realistic scale with fully functioning rides and 7500+ 3D models!

There are thousands of unlockable cosmetics, achivements, quests and more for you to explore!
